title: Unpaid Settlement Lawsuit: Newmans sue association and 33 residents; $200,000 settlement shares remain unpaid
summary_full: In De Pere, Wisconsin, a family faces a contentious dispute with their homeowners association regarding a fence. After winning a $200,000 settlement for being denied permission to build a fence for their children, tensions have escalated. The association has spread the financial burden among property owners, many of whom have failed to contribute.
